name: kansas_2012_gdp
title: Kansas 2012 income tax cuts: real GDP per capita (secondary)

design.outcome_label: Real GDP per capita, log points relative to the state's 1997-2011 mean (x100)
design.policy_note: Senate Substitute for H.B. 2117 signed 22 May 2012, effective tax year 2013: top rate 6.45% -> 4.9%, pass-through business income exempted. Proposed in the January 2012 State of the State address, so 2012 is treated as the first exposed year (anticipation).
